The Future of Sustainable Fashion Let's explore how we can make better choices in fashion to help the environment. Facts and figures: The fashion industry is responsible for 10% of (1) _______, and it generates an estimated 92 million tonnes of textile waste each year. (2) _______ the growing amount of textile waste, the fashion industry needs to find more sustainable solutions to reduce its negative impact on the environment. Additionally, producing just one cotton shirt eats up 2,700 litres of water - enough for one person to drink for two and a half years! Positive action: • Buy clothes made from sustainable materials like organic cotton or recycled fabrics. This reduces the need (3) _______ excessive water use and chemical (4) _______. • Instead of always purchasing new clothes, try second-hand shopping or swapping clothes with friends. This helps reduce the production of too (5) _______ unnecessary clothing items and lower textile waste. • Take care of your clothes properly! Washing them at lower temperatures and avoiding tumble dryers can (6) _______ their lifespan and reduce energy use. • For unwanted clothes, consider donating them instead of throwing them away. (Adapted from BBC Learning)
passages.p2: Read the following passage and mark the letter A, B, C or D to indicate the best answer to each of the questions from 23 to 30. WELLBEING 2026: FROM PHYSICAL TARGETS TO DIGITAL DETOX In recent years, wellbeing has become a multi-trillion-pound industry, evolving from simple supplements to a complex endeavour. While 2025 was dominated by intense gym targets and AI-driven meal plans, the trend in 2026 has shifted significantly towards "Recovery". Experts suggest that the old "no pain, no gain" philosophy, which has underpinned fitness for decades, is being replaced by a more sophisticated understanding of health. Smart technology has played a pivotal role in this transformation. Modern smartwatches do more than just track runs; they provide deep insights into our biological data. By monitoring heart rates and movement patterns, these devices warn users when they have overtrained and highlight the necessity of rest days. This data-driven approach allows individuals to reframe rest not just as "taking time off," but as a strategic component of staying fit. Consequently, technology has empowered us to "give ourselves a break" rather than training ourselves into the ground. Alongside physical recovery, a new psychological movement is seeping into our consciousness: JOMO, or the "Joy of Missing Out." This concept serves as a counter-movement to FOMO (Fear of Missing Out), a term first recognised in 2004 that describes the anxiety of keeping up with the sparkling lives shown on social media. After two decades of digital pressure, people are now prioritising their mental health by reducing the need for external validation. Jak Phillips, a fitness growth director, argues that JOMO is about becoming more comfortable in our own choices, whether regarding the frequency of our workouts or our social lives. Instead of spreading themselves too thinly to stay across everything, individuals are learning to say no. This shift marks a significant milestone in wellbeing, where success is measured not by how much we do, but by how well we recover and disconnect. (Adapted from https://www.bbc.com)

passages.p4: Read the following passage and mark the letter A, B, C or D to indicate the best answer to each of the questions from 20 to 29. [I] In early 2025, scientists achieved a breakthrough in renewable energy technology. [II] Researchers from the Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) developed a new type of solar panel that is significantly more efficient than existing models. [III] The new technology employs advanced materials and innovative design to capture a broader spectrum of sunlight, converting it into electricity with an efficiency rate of over 40%. [IV] In addition to being more efficient, the new solar panels are also more cost-effective to produce. The researchers use a combination of perovskite and silicon materials, both of which are abundant and inexpensive. This development has the potential to make renewable energy more accessible and affordable for a broader range of people. Currently, the team is focused on scaling up production and testing the panels in real-world conditions to ensure their durability and long-term performance. This breakthrough comes at a critical time as the world grapples with the impacts of climate change. The increased efficiency of the new solar panels means that more clean energy can be generated from the same amount of sunlight, thereby reducing reliance on fossil fuels and lowering greenhouse gas emissions. This advancement aligns with global efforts to transition to a more sustainable energy future and to combat the adverse effects of climate change. The announcement of this breakthrough has been met with excitement and optimism from both the scientific community and environmental advocates. The potential for widespread adoption of this new solar technology could revolutionize the renewable energy sector and accelerate the transition to a greener, more sustainable world. As further developments and testing continue, the world watches with anticipation for the positive impact this innovation will bring. (Adapted from nature.com)
passages.p5: Read the following passage and mark the letter A, B, C or D to indicate the option that best fits each of the number blanks from 30 to 34. In recent years, artificial intelligence (AI) has developed quickly and is now playing a big role in the world of content creation. Tools like ChatGPT can write articles, Midjourney can create detailed images, and Google Veo, introduced in 2024, can make realistic videos from just a few words. These tools are fast, low-cost, and available to many people, which makes them very attractive. Because of this, some people (30) _______. However, creating content is not just about speed or technical skill. It also involves telling meaningful stories, expressing deep emotions, and sharing ideas from a personal or cultural point of view. (31) _______. For example, when a person makes a video about their childhood in a poor neighborhood, they bring real memories, struggles, and emotions that an AI simply cannot copy. Though AI can produce something that looks or sounds good, it often lacks the feeling, meaning, and human connection that audiences care about. (32) _______. Instead of replacing content creators, AI is more likely to change the way they work. Creators (33) _______ can save time, try out more ideas, and make their content even better. For example, a writer can use AI to generate ideas or edit faster, while still keeping their unique voice. In the future, the best content may come from people who know how to combine their creativity with the power of AI. Rather than seeing AI as a threat, (34) _______. (Adapted from forbes.com)
passages.p6: Read the following advertisement and mark the letter A, B, C, or D on your answer sheet to indicate the correct option that best fits each of the numbered blanks from 35 to 40. Fansipan - The Highest Place to Touch the Sky in Vietnam Standing proudly at 3,147.3 meters above sea level, Fansipan, known as the “Rooftop of Indochina”, is the perfect place to witness Vietnam’s breathtaking natural beauty and spiritual calm. Nestled in the misty Hoang Lien Son range of Lao Cai Province, the mountain offers travelers an experience that brings a new (35) _______ of excitement. From lush valleys and terraced fields to sacred temples near the summit, every step unveils a deeper connection to nature and culture. Those (36) _______ reach the summit can witness a breathtaking sea of clouds and feel a true sense of accomplishment. Modern infrastructure has made the journey more (37) _______ than ever. The Sun World Fansipan Legend cable car dramatically (38) _______ travel time, allowing visitors of all ages (39) _______ through seas of clouds in just minutes, while adventurous hikers can still (40) _______ the trail on foot for a sense of triumph that no shortcut can replace. Whether you come to chase sunrise over the northern peaks, breathe in crisp mountain air, or honor Vietnam’s diverse ethnic heritage, Fansipan remains a destination to truly feel on top of the world. (Adapted from tourtravelworld.com)
